title: Notes Java Introduction To Number Manipulation Programs

items.question: Write a Java program that prints all prime numbers from 1 to 20.
Write a Java program that reads a positive integer n and prints all prime numbers from 1 to n.
Write a Java program that reads a non-negative integer and reverses its digits using a while loop.
Write a Java program that reads a non-negative integer and counts its digits using a while loop.
Write a Java program that reads a non-negative integer and calculates the sum of its digits using a while loop.
Write a Java program that reads a non-negative integer and determines whether it is a palindrome.
Write a Java program that reads a non-negative integer, squares each digit, and calculates the sum of the squared digits.
Write a Java program that reads a non-negative integer and determines whether it is an Armstrong number.
